name: 曲名と保存操作
prompt:
Create a single Japanese now-playing metadata strip with an actual 359x64 canvas, aspect ratio 5.61:1. Do not center the row inside a tall or standard landscape canvas. Fill the full 64 px height with the row surface and its text/actions; leave no large blank bands above or below. The strip itself must span the canvas width.

Use a pure white #FFFFFF surface and the exact Japanese copy: title “いつもの光” in Meiryo Bold 20 px with 28 px line height, zero tracking and #1D1D1D; subtitle “灯りの音楽隊” in Meiryo Regular 14 px with 24 px line height, zero tracking and #6E6E6E. Follow the source crop inset and vertically centered two-line stack. Place the close X followed by an outlined plus-circle at the right, both slate #526173, matching the source action silhouettes.

Return the strip alone at 359x64. No surrounding canvas, phone frame, status bar, album art, playback timeline, extra controls, extra text, texture, shadow, gradient, mint tint or green action color. The Japanese mock/native supplies wording and typography; current DESIGN.md supplies the white/slate palette.
reviewNotes: Raw result is 1680x936 at 1.795:1, while the assigned frame is 359x64 at 5.609:1. At 359 px wide with aspect preserved, the canvas is 359x200 with large blank top and bottom bands. The Japanese title, artist and slate close/add actions remain on white. Stored raw without crop or stretch; geometry and margins need correction.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
